resolution_note: Horizon EOD 2026-06-05. Araghchi stated Jun 4: 'There is no formal negotiation process underway between Iran and the United States.' No signed document confirmed by named US and Iranian principals. All three indicators (Witkoff/Araghchi meeting, Trump statement, mediator channel reopened) remain NOT_OBSERVED. MOU draft stalled since 28 May; Iran suspended mediator-channel communications Jun 1. Successor: F8 (Iran–US MOU by Jun 30).

Horizon EOD 2026-06-10. IMF PortWatch recorded ~4–10 transits/day vs 95/day pre-crisis baseline. Rubio confirmed Jun 2 that Iran mined 'large segments' of Hormuz; demining estimated at 4–6 months. Maersk/MSC/CMA CGM/Hapag-Lloyd have not resumed. No MOU signed; Iran suspended talks Jun 1. Reaching >=50/day 7-day average within 6 days is physically implausible. Successor: F5 (Hormuz >=50/day by Jul 2, p=0.22).
